entities.summary: Ottoman Empire, a political institution in Eritrea during Medieval Eritrea: Islam and Isolation (1557–1865). Grew from Ottoman Capture Massawa 1557 and Dahlak Sultanate. Led to the emergence of Egyptian Control of the Coast.
